name: pantheon
description: Makes Claude a lead that delegates to specialist roles as native Claude subagents, with an auto-opening /pantheon panel for roles, activity and a session log, and a strip above the prompt with model, context, cache, rate limits and running agents.

gate.title: Main-session edit gate
gate.description: Holds or denies main-session edits that local size and path rules do not consider trivial.

jevApiKey.title: Jev API key
jevApiKey.description: OpenRouter API key for the flow judge. Falls back to OPENROUTER_API_KEY when unset. The edit gate does not use it.

abovePrompt.title: Above-prompt strip
abovePrompt.description: Shows the info, usage and limits rows above the prompt, plus a summary of the roles running now. Turn it off to hide the strip.

paceStart.title: Pace start (points)
paceStart.description: How many points of the 5-hour and 7-day limits you may be ahead of the clock before the bar turns amber with a ▲ (up to it, there is no mark). 0 flags any lead; 5 ignores a lead of up to 5 points. Red still starts beyond 15 points ahead, or at 90% used.
